text:
ara (Marketing): Quick sync — we need a crisp benchmark narrative for the launch comms and webinar. Goal: 3 microcharts + 3 one-line takeaways, plus inbound routing. Keep claims conservative and attribution-ready.

devin (Analytics): Proposed charts:
1) p50/p95 vs engagement lift (scatter/delta)
2) tokens-per-dollar by batch and quantization (bar)
3) tail-risk heatmap (p99 error rate vs latency)

jas (Design): I can do card + slide + webinar thumbnail. Card: single-line hero (<90 chars) + tiny caption. Webinar slide: 3-up with 1-line takeaway under each. Thumbnail: bold before/after snapshot.

rachel (Growth): Routing idea: single dropdown on demo landing: "What's most important?" (Speed / Cost / Predictability). Map to: speed -> Perf demo, cost -> ROI calc, predictability -> SLA consult. Add UTM param.

owen (Product): Data to use: POC-11 numbers from devin — keep as "customer POC". Also call out model family and prompt assumptions in footnote.

devin (Analytics): POC-11 excerpt:
```
baseline: p95 340ms, tokens/$ = 0.026 optimized: p95 68ms, tokens/$ = 0.019 engagement delta: +19% (task complete) est savings: ~22% per 1M tokens
```

ara (Marketing): Nice. One-line hooks draft:
- Chart1: "Faster median and tighter tail = ~20% more task success"
- Chart2: "Optimize batching + quant = predictable token $ savings"
- Chart3: "Control p99 to avoid costly retries and SLA hits"

jas (Design): I'll annotate 3 decision anchors on each: "speed-first", "balanced", "cost-first" and include a small legend for assumptions. Colors will match brand.

rachel (Growth): CTA variants: "Schedule a perf demo" vs "Run our ROI calc". We'll A/B test by audience (SaaS vs platform).

owen (Product): Microcase to include on slide: "Customer X: helpdesk bot — p95 340 -> 68ms; task success +19%; net token cost -22%". Frame as 'customer POC (anonymized)'.

devin (Analytics): I'll export CSV + fig snips. Also add a short table of assumptions: avg prompt length, token mix, model family, quantization.

asset-bot: Uploaded /benchmarks/poc11_summary.csv (sha256: b7f9d3...)

ara (Marketing): Copy variants for hero (short):
A: "Faster replies. Better outcomes. See the benchmark."
B: "Cut wait, raise success — benchmarked for real apps."

jas (Design): Both good. I'll make two card comps. Which to push in paid?

rachel (Growth): Use A in paid, B organic. Paid CTA = perf demo. Organic CTA = ROI calc.

owen (Product): Legal check: use cautious phrasing: "~20% task success lift; up to ~25% token savings depending on workload." Also call out that results vary.

devin (Analytics): Note for visuals: show shaded bands for variance. Don't present single-point guarantees.

ara (Marketing): Final asset checklist:
- chart PNGs + slide (jas)
- annotated data + CSV (devin)
- hero copy + CTAs (rachel)
- routing modal content + UTM plan (rachel)
- legal-approved microcase copy (owen)

jas (Design): GIF request: 3-frame CDF shift (p95 compressing) -> I'll deliver subtle & bold exports.

asset-bot: Uploaded /art/cards/poc11_card_A.png (sha256: c0a1...), /art/cards/poc11_card_B.png (sha256: d9e2...)

rachel (Growth): Timeline: drop final assets by 1731234899. I'll wire the landing modal and set up A/B test flags.

owen (Product): Also add a short FAQ bullet on the slide: "How we measured" + link to methodology doc. We'll avoid dollar claims without context.

ara (Marketing): Perfect. Everyone, please drop final assets + sign-offs by deadline. I'll assemble launch thread + webinar invite copy after that. Thanks! :rocket:
